articles.title: Chemed to Report Fourth-Quarter 2025 Earnings February 25, Related Conference Call to Be Held on February 26
articles.mainIdea: Chemed to Report Fourth-Quarter 2025 Earnings February 25, Related Conference Call to Be Held on February 26
articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: Chemed to Report Fourth-Quarter 2025 Earnings February 25, Related Conference Call to Be Held on February 26. CINCINNATI, Jan. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Chemed Corporation (NYSE: CHE) today announced that it will release financial results for the fourth quarter ended December 31, 2025, on Wednesday, February 25, 2026, following the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange. Chemed will host a conference call and webcast at 10 a.m., ET, on Thursday, February 26, 2026, to discuss the company's quarterly results and to provide an update on its business. articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: Independent Bank Corporation Announces Date for Its Fourth Quarter 2025 Earnings Release. GRAND RAPIDS, Mich., Dec. 31, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Independent Bank Corporation (NASDAQ: IBCP), the holding company of Independent Bank, a Michigan-based community bank, announced that it expects to issue its 2025 fourth quarter results on Thursday, January 22, 2026, at approximately 8:00 am ET. The release will be available on the Internet at IndependentBank.com within the “News” section of the “Investor Relations” area of the Company’s website.
